proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection handshake/state machine, QP/ECE negotiation, QoS traffic-class/service-level handling, FLID/GID routing, receive-size reporting, connect/abort cleanup, and MR registration cache behavior. Added gin because GIN IB paths are independently updated (traffic-class normalization/validation, connect flow integration with new IB connect/abort semantics), not just incidental call-site edits.
